# MHA Screening - Mental Health America

> > Free mental health screening tools, educational resources, and crisis support from Mental Health America in English and Spanish.

Mental Health America's screening platform provides evidence-based mental health assessments, bilingual educational content on conditions like depression, anxiety, PTSD, and bipolar disorder, plus practical support resources for individuals, families, and youth navigating mental health challenges.

## Key Topics

- Mental Health America (MHA)
- Depression and anxiety treatment
- PTSD and trauma recovery
- Bipolar disorder management
- Self-harm prevention
- Mental health worksheets
- Spanish mental health resources (salud mental)
- LGBTQ+ culturally competent care
- Social Security Disability (SSI/SSDI)
- Special education services (IEP)
- Medication management
- Grounding techniques
- Therapeutic writing
- Youth mental health support
- Parent and family resources

## Mental Health Support Hubs

- [Self-Harm Information & Support](https://screening.mhanational.org/self-harm): MHA self-harm support hub with crisis resources and prevention info
- [Información y apoyo para jóvenes (Youth Support - Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/juventud): Spanish youth mental health support hub by Mental Health America
- [Parents Information & Support (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/parents): Spanish parent support hub for mental health and addiction by MHA
- [Trauma y TEPT - Información y apoyo (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/trauma-trastorno-por-estres-postraumatico): Spanish PTSD and trauma support hub by Mental Health America

## Mental Health Conditions & Treatment

- [¿Qué es la depresión? (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/que-es-la-depresion): Spanish educational guide on depression symptoms and mood disorders
- [Veo u oigo cosas que no existen (Psychosis - Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/veo-u-oigo-cosas-que-no-estan-ahi): Spanish guide on psychosis symptoms and hallucinations by MHA National
- [I like my mania](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/i-like-my-mania): Addresses treatment ambivalence in bipolar disorder and mania
- [I feel better. Can I go off my meds?](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/i-feel-better-should-i-go-my-meds): Guidance on medication management and stopping mental health medications
- [¿Volverá la depresión? (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/will-depression-come-back): Spanish guide on recurrent depression risk factors and prevention
- [Can yoga help improve my mental health?](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/can-yoga-help-improve-my-mental-health): Yoga benefits for depression, anxiety, PTSD, and ADHD management

## Coping Skills & Worksheets

- [Procesando el trauma y el estrés (Spanish Worksheet)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/hoja-de-trabajo-para-procesar-el-trauma-y-el-estres): Spanish worksheet for trauma processing with grounding techniques
- [Cómo afrontar el peor de los casos (Spanish Worksheet)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/hoja-de-trabajo-como-afrontar-el-peor-de-los-casos): Spanish worksheet for catastrophic thinking and cognitive restructuring
- [I feel trapped](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/i-feel-trapped): Coping strategies and peer support resources for feeling trapped

## Getting Help & Finding Support

- [¿Qué debo buscar en un terapeuta? (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/what-should-i-look-therapist): Spanish guide on selecting culturally competent LGBTQ+ therapists
- [¿Cómo puedo pedir ayuda a mis amigos y familiares? (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/how-do-i-ask-my-friends-and-family-help): Spanish guide on asking family and friends for mental health support
- [Apoyando a los demás (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/apoyando-los-demas): Spanish guide on active listening and supporting others' mental health

## Benefits & Services Navigation

- [Is my child eligible for assistance if they can't work?](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/my-child-eligible-assistance-if-they-cant-work): SSI and Social Security disability benefits eligibility for adult children
- [How do I get special ed services for my child?](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/how-do-i-get-special-ed-services-my-child): Parent guide to IEP process and IDEA special education services

## Complementary & Alternative Treatments

- [Kava](https://screening.mhanational.org/content/kava): Kava herbal supplement info: anxiety treatment, liver toxicity, FDA warnings
- [Inositol (Spanish)](https://screening.mhanational.org/es/contenido/inositol): Spanish guide on Inositol (Vitamin B8) for depression and anxiety
